Objective.description: What the unit is for, in one line, as the person or agent stated it.

ProjectId.description: Identifies a project: one Git repository Nodal manages units for.

Slug.description: The CLI handle for a unit, derived from its branch.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant, serialised as an RFC 3339 string.

UnitId.description: Identifies a `WorkUnit`. Stable for the life of the work, across machines.

UnitStatus.description:
Where a unit is in its life. The branch, not the directory, is the identity a
reviewer or another tool sees, so a unit outlives any one materialisation.

oneOf.description: Being worked on; holds its branch against other units.
Merged; runtime may be stopped, the delta is still kept.
Kept for the record only; nothing of it is running.

branch.description: The branch this unit owns. Unique among open units, enforced by the registry.

id.description: Identity of the unit; stable across machines and re-materialisations.

objective.description: The stated intent, when there is one. Adoption may recover it later.

parent_branch.description: The branch the work started from, when it is known.

project_id.description: The project the unit belongs to.

status.description: Where the unit is in its life.

updated_at.description: When any of the above last changed.
